evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Specifies a large, complex capability (content identification/fingerprinting) without scope, success criteria, or acceptance boundaries, making a reasonable implementation estimate infeasible.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded functionality (use profile to influence search/recommendation) that can be scoped and estimated (e.g., simple preference filtering or weighted ranking).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Describes a collaborative-recommendation approach that is concrete enough to size (e.g., implement user-similarity and recommend engine) despite implementation choices.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Defines a specific feature (content-similarity based search) that can be estimated (compare content features, return similar items).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Clear mechanism (use enriched metadata and tags) and outcome described; scoping options allow reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Specifies a concrete pipeline requirement (persist tags and expose to processing) that is straightforward to scope and estimate.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: A specific UI feature (thumbnail sequences) with clear implementation steps and estimatable effort.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Although 'info' is generic, the intent (expose metadata about similar items/segments) is implementable and can be scoped for estimation (e.g., list similar items + metadata fields).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Specifies perceptual similarity as the similarity metric; this is a concrete criterion allowing reasonable estimation of detection and metadata exposure tasks.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Clear recommendation feature (use similar profiles) that can be scoped (e.g., simple CF algorithm) and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Although 'most relevant' is subjective, the mechanism (news-event-based recommendations scoped by geography/time) is definable and estimatable with reasonable assumptions.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Concrete detection/recognition feature (person identification + link to info). Complexity is high but the scope is clear enough to produce an implementation estimate (prototype vs production).

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: A defined object-detection + metadata lookup feature that can be scoped and estimated (model integration, metadata source).

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection task (logos) with predictable implementation approaches; estimatable with defined acceptance criteria.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Similar to product/logo detection; concrete feature that can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Clear user flow (upload/take photo -> get related videos) that can be implemented incrementally and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based content discovery is a well-defined feature; scope can be split (map UI, geospatial query), allowing reasonable estimates.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a concrete technical feature (index ASR transcripts, allow text search) and can be scoped for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Administrative UI and editing operations are specific and implementable; estimatable by component (view, validate, edit).

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines annotation UI and topic extraction; both are definable tasks and can be estimated (manual vs automated extraction options).

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by measurable A/V metrics is concrete and scoping options enable reasonable estimation (which metrics, thresholds).

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: A specific detection capability (edited vs raw audio). While algorithmically challenging, the requirement is concrete enough to estimate a prototype or production solution.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Content moderation for nudity is a focused feature with known approaches; scoping (sensitivity/thresholds) allows estimation.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset based prefiltering is a clearly scoped capability (use file/codec/resolution/etc.) and can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is broad but concrete (fingerprinting, metadata matching); while complex, it is scoping-able and estimatable (prototype vs full coverage).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Clear mechanism (search on metadata/tags) and outcome; scoping options support estimation.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Terms like 'interesting' and 'appealing' are subjective and underspecified; without clear metrics or acceptance criteria a reasonable implementation estimate cannot be made.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Defines data sources (annotations, Talk) and desired outcome (trigger prompting); scoping (rules/thresholds) makes estimation possible.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer classification is a concrete analytics task (define types, features), and can be scoped for effort estimation.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Clearly specified approach (simple low-level features) and target (preclassification) allow straightforward estimation.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Well-bounded detection task with clear acceptance (no classifiable animals) that can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection goal (image series due to timestamp malfunction) and data context allow scoping and estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: A clearly described ML preclassification task; complexity notwithstanding, it can be scoped and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Specifies attributes preclassification; task is concrete and scoping choices allow estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a defined computer-vision task that can be scoped and estimated (accuracy, edge cases).

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Concrete image segmentation/localization task with clear scope; estimatable per dataset/model choice.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Clear detection goal (no classifiable plankton) and dataset context make estimation feasible.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Specific measurable attributes (size/orientation) define the task and allow reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Concrete species preclassification task; can be scoped by species set and dataset to estimate effort.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Defines a focused feature (motion analysis to trim video) with measurable outcomes and scoping options for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: A specific event-detection task with clear acceptance (time of egg-laying), enabling reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Multiple detection targets are listed but each is a concrete computer-vision task; with per-feature scoping, estimation is feasible.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: A definable analytics model (weight by experience) that can be scoped (features, thresholds) and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Specific prefiltering goals with example artefacts; implementation approach is clear enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Well-bounded detection task (moving/transient objects) that can be scoped and estimated (algorithms, thresholds).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Specific audio-processing requirement with known techniques; scoping (levels of quality) enables estimation.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping of similar calls is a concrete signal-processing task and can be scoped for effort estimation.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting distinct sources in audio is a defined task (source separation/estimation) and can be estimated given dataset constraints.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: No triggers, inputs or acceptance criteria provided; the condition 'when' is underspecified, preventing a reasonable implementation estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Lacks criteria for choosing modality or definitions of circumstances; without rules or measurable inputs this is too vague to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: The trigger conditions for 'educate' are unspecified (what constitutes need), making it impossible to form a reasonable implementation estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: No decision criteria or context for selecting media type; underspecified modality-selection logic prevents reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: No definition of available 'pieces of education', nor criteria for choice; selection logic is underspecified and cannot be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: 'Interesting' is subjective and no measurable criteria are provided, making the condition underspecified and not estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: No triggering rules or success criteria for bot comments are given; absence of decision logic prevents reasonable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified triggers and lack of acceptance criteria for when explanations are needed makes estimating implementation effort infeasible.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: No constraints, templates, or content scope are provided; generating appropriate bot messages is underspecified and hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Clustering/grouping is a concrete task; implementation approaches and scoping options make it estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: A specific recommendation feature with clear input (previous experiences); can be scoped and estimated (simple rules or ML models).

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization is a defined feature (generate summaries) and can be scoped (length, extractive vs abstractive) for estimation.
